To find the stationary points, you need to find the derivative of the function f(x). Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are the critical points. replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, you standardize the data. You can project the data onto these components to reduce dimensionality. The math can be complex, but there are many tools and software that can help you perform PCA without getting too anxious about the underlying mathematics.
